ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (dark grey/black) background interspersed with numerous high-intensity (white) focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface presents a uniform dark-grey base. High-contrast white circular pixel blobs are distributed across both lobes, with a significantly higher spatial density and clustering observed on the left lobe compared to the right.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central depression is a shallow U-shaped notch with a wide, obtuse vertex angle and low bounding-box depth relative to the total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits continuous, fine-grained serration. The boundary is defined by low-amplitude, high-frequency irregular peaks and valleys, particularly pronounced towards the distal regions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges follow a predominantly convex curve from the central notch to the tips, with localized irregularities near the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters are detected. The left lobe contains a dense constellation of approximately 30+ focal spots, while the right lobe shows more isolated and sparsely distributed clusters.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, prominent, diagonal linear white mark is detected on the upper-medial quadrant of the right lobe, cutting through the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular, white/beige textured protrusions are visible at both distal tips, indicating significant localized tissue irregularity or parasite colonization. The right lobe also contains a distinct straight-line scar.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of high-density circular scarring on the left lobe and a singular prominent diagonal linear abrasion on the right lobe.
